latest_fy.basis: Fiscal-year revenue for the period ended 2025-12-31: 22,136,400,000 EUR from the yfinance-statements statements in HO-PA.json.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Compound annual revenue growth computed as (22,136,400,000/17,568,800,000)**(1/3.0007)-1 from the yfinance-statements revenue series, period ended 2022-12-31 to period ended 2025-12-31.

operating_margin.basis: Operating income 2,218,700,000 EUR divided by revenue 22,136,400,000 EUR, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow 3,321,800,000 EUR divided by net income 1,674,500,000 EUR, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 3,321,800,000 EUR less capex 756,700,000 EUR, divided by revenue 22,136,400,000 EUR, all for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 1,683,000,000 EUR (total debt 6,129,500,000 less cash 4,446,500,000, as of 2025-12-31) divided by an EBITDA proxy 3,306,000,000 EUR (operating income 2,218,700,000 plus depreciation 1,087,300,000 for the period ended 2025-12-31), from the yfinance-statements series.

piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 8 (state STRONG) computed over yfinance-statements statements in HO-PA.json quality.piotroski, 9 of 9 inputs found.

beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score -2.769 against the -1.78 threshold, earnings-manipulation state CLEAN, computed over yfinance-statements statements in HO-PA.json quality.beneish, 12 of 12 inputs found.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 50,691,280,254.10 EUR from quality.derived.market_cap in HO-PA.json, computed over yfinance-statements shares and price (statement and price currency both EUR, no mismatch).

price_to_sales.basis: Price-to-sales 2.2900: market capitalization 50,691,280,254.10 EUR divided by fiscal-year revenue 22,136,400,000 EUR for the period ended 2025-12-31.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 52374280254.1 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 2565100000.0, solved by bisection at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth, from HO-PA.json quality.reverse_dcf. Assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods ({'5': 0.0859, '7': 0.0705, '10': 0.0593}) in HO-PA.json quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon; inherits the same assumed discount rate and terminal growth.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. NULL is a field looked for in the fetched market file and not found or not computable, with the specific reason on the field itself, never estimated.
